outcome: adverse neonatal outcomes (e.g., macrosomia, neonatal hypoglycemia, NICU admission)
cohort: 250 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus who delivered at a tertiary care hospital between 2017 and 2022.
finding: Women with GDM experienced an increased risk of cesarean delivery (47%), macrosomia (22%), neonatal hypoglycemia (18%), NICU admission (20%), and hypertensive disorders (14%).
mod_finding: The cesarean delivery rate was 47% in women with GDM, which was higher than in the general obstetric population.
